residual_risks.mitigation: Static contract map, all-stage synthetic manifest coverage, bounded branch fixtures, and strict artifact sealing.
residual_risks.risk: D11-D22 and O00-O19 have not all executed in a complete fresh formal run.

residual_risks.mitigation: Fail-closed lock plus read-only process/heartbeat validation prevents duplicate launch.
residual_risks.risk: Abrupt host loss can leave scheduler.lock until operator triage.

verified_defects.defect: Stage manifests sealed only stage_result.json, not downstream scientific artifacts.
verified_defects.failure_mode: A corrupted checkpoint, field, or summary could remain resume-eligible.
verified_defects.fix: Canonical per-stage artifact contracts are included in the strict output manifest.

verified_defects.defect: latest_checkpoint.json SHA/root/boundary semantics were not verified before torch.load.
verified_defects.failure_mode: A stale, replaced, or wrong-kind checkpoint could be deserialized and resumed.
verified_defects.fix: Fail-closed pointer validation now precedes deserialization.

verified_defects.defect: Restored writer/reader tensors were not checked against checkpoint module hashes.
verified_defects.failure_mode: Internal state corruption could survive strict load_state_dict.
verified_defects.fix: Post-load module hashes must exactly match checkpoint identities.

verified_defects.defect: D06B/D22 prior-stage checks omitted run UUID/root/config/contract identity.
verified_defects.failure_mode: A self-consistent foreign stage prefix could pass the manual gate audit.
verified_defects.fix: Gate-time prior-stage validation now uses the full formal identity.

verified_defects.defect: 401/499 field validators omitted binding, count, shape, checkpoint, and add provenance checks.
verified_defects.failure_mode: Malformed shuffle B, wrong checkpoint, or incorrect 401+98 composition could reach evaluation.
